title: C05/V03: pin parent-domain incompatibilities and recover missing source
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Records a source-pinned negative interface result: the proposed V03 prefix cannot use the unchanged production parent/receiver/domain path. The parent requires its original driver,26-file/two-build receiver and empty stderr; domain terminal facts require returncode0, the process has a four-domain limit, and closure census/binding/literal rules constrain a successor. The copied-native route also requires fresh file-backed mappings in the copied view.

This32-file package recovers11 inert source/readiness copies and checks14 AST-located anchors plus4 literal bindings. It is a **source audit**, not a new control supervisor, original execution, C05/V03 completion, measured speedup or κ result.

## Task and overlap

User-assigned original C05/full named V03 under the portable-replay task. Scope changed from integration construction to the concrete source-gate audit when the actual parent interface failed that gate; the original completion objective and all production checks remain unchanged.

Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; published head `a8cf650b7435ccea237084e491e339f725c0a35b`; tree `656fa658961baf6b38443b81a343dbfc34e33da6` matches byte-checked local commit528e7c81f10792d664cb8095db0c92052c4e6bf0.

Canonical thread #6321. #6352 (`b280be8dab15359159538e639b1d8c7deafc0612`) supplied prior entry/parent questions; #6362 (`120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e`) implemented partial input-edge/prefix/data helpers. This audit adds actual recovered parent/domain/closure/epoch/supervisor source and the consequent incompatibilities, rather than treating a generic “genuine parent” as implemented.

The refreshed23-node bounded PR metadata graph is in evidence/PR-COVERAGE.json. This also corrects a delivery gap: the earlier PR6362 prompt/body referred to a PR-COVERAGE file that was local session material and was not exported there. Current PR metadata is distinct from full current-head source review.

## Validation

Executed locally with Python3.12:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-c05-v03-parent-interface-audit
```

All passed for the final adjusted export. The registered command authenticates archive bytes and checks source structure/anchors only. It never imports archived originals or runs original Root/provider/parent/native/compiler/namespace work. Metadata scaffold failures are retained. Independent Sol Max source and export review accepted the narrowed findings after correcting anonymous-mapping and literal-registry scope wording. Hosted results are pending submission.

Unit02 closed at its15-minute source gate before implementation; publication is a separate disposition. Pro4 subsequently completed and identifies same-build generated GCC plugin data as the next distinct dependency. Full C05/V03 remain false; original43.5%/22of49,stage2/10,milestones1/10,24components and52helpers are unchanged. No original budget expanded; guard debit94.550533479/2400 is not full physical cost. Outside preparation/review/publication/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. App goal separately observed paused.

Inert sources retain notices; new verification/archive code Apache-2.0. Agent/source/archive review is distinct from human, native and original scientific acceptance.

## Open next questions

See the package README. Construct and independently review a separate control-only supervisor/terminal accessor and clean authenticated bootstrap while preserving original production acceptance, actual Popen/domain/error/raw ownership and original caps. Separately finish actual compiler configuration/query closure and immutable witness interval before original stage/command/funding/execution admission. No lease, serialized capability, registry reset or production-completion mint can replace those requirements.
